entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5900705244680192: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 11.0406 +/- 0.0182 mas (same row, RUWE 1.43): 90.58 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 169.712, -76.792 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.662052 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5532 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). Mass 0.636 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 318836983 (VizieR IV/39/tic82); no NASA Exoplanet Archive row gives one, nor does Gaia DR3 FLAME (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ab3467). Temperature 4208.45 K from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5532 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,208.45 K and log g 4.6 (u1 0.718, u2 0.068): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
